name: CLEARWORLD
source:
Utopia, the shadows of truth hidden in this clear world.

Utopia—an ideal said to have now been realized through the evolution of science.

However, it isn't open to everyone.

There are those who are chosen, and those who are not.

There are those who will accept new values as part of this evolution, and those who will still cling to old traditions.

Have you the courage to search for the truth amidst this ideal that evolution has given you?

[Translated from [url=https://clearworld.jp/about/]Homepage[/url]]
